title: The man who survived BOTH atomic bombs
voiceover: On August sixth, nineteen forty-five, a Japanese engineer named Tsutomu Yamaguchi was on a business trip in Hiroshima when the first atomic bomb dropped. He was less than two miles from the blast. He survived... burned, deafened in one ear, but alive. He took a train home the next day to recover. Home was Nagasaki. Three days later, the second bomb dropped. He was at work, telling his boss what happened in Hiroshima... when the sky lit up again. And he survived that too. He lived to ninety-three. Follow for one mind-blowing fact a day.
